items.prompt:
Text A says 50 deaths; Text B says 200. This is a disagreement of:
A) fact
B) interpretation
C) spelling

Text A calls a law 'bold reform'; Text B calls it 'dangerous overreach.' This is a disagreement of:
A) interpretation
B) fact
C) font

When two sources conflict, a reader should:
A) seek more reliable sources
B) pick one at random
C) ignore the topic

Two reliable sources give different DATES for the same event. This is a disagreement of:
A) fact
B) interpretation
C) opinion

steps: Dates are factual. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Two historians agree on what happened but disagree on how important it was. This is a disagreement of:
A) interpretation
B) fact
C) spelling

If two sources disagree on a FACT, at least one must be:
A) inaccurate
B) perfectly correct
C) an opinion

steps: Facts can't both differ and both be right. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

One article reports a drug cured 90% of patients; another, using the same study, reports it cured 40%.

To resolve this FACTUAL conflict, the best step is to:
A) check the original study and other reliable sources
B) believe whichever number is higher
C) assume both are opinions
items.answer: A) check the original study and other reliable sources

steps: Verify the fact. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) check the original study and other reliable sources

items.prompt:
When two texts conflict, a skilled reader FIRST identifies:
A) whether the disagreement is about facts or interpretation
B) which text is longer
C) which author is older
items.answer: A) whether the disagreement is about facts or interpretation

steps: Fact vs interpretation. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) whether the disagreement is about facts or interpretation
